Episode 260. Patriarch Succession Ceremony (2)
"Such gloomy talk. Go see Jin after chatting with us for a bit. Don't you think he's nervous too? I hear it's something he's dreamed of since his past life. Go and comfort him a little, as a father."
"Even if an era of peace has arrived, Runcandel is still Runcandel. Do you think such things suit us?"
The people nodded. It was because they knew the side of Chiron he had shown since overcoming his demonization.
"...Hmm, is that so?"
There were three hours left until noon, when the patriarch succession ceremony would begin.
Chiron spent two of those hours talking more with those seated. They were ordinary stories. In other words, they were stories about life.
"Ozdok."
[Yes, my lord!]
"The succession ceremony begins in an hour, so start letting the people in."
[Understood!]
"Well then, I'll see you all later."
Soon, Chiron, who had risen from his seat, walked towards the balcony on the top floor of the mansion.
"Father."
It was Jin, standing on one side of the corridor leading to the balcony.
"It seems you were waiting."
"Yes. Because I knew you would be greeting the guests here, Father."
"You rascal, are you already trying to act like the master alongside this father? There is still an hour left."
Chiron looked at Jin with a smiling face.
"You seemed busy lately, Father. Every time I came to talk to you, you had gone to meet someone."
"What did you want to talk to me about?"
"Just... wanted to talk about life. I was also secretly hoping you might be inclined to pour me a drink."
"Hmm, you speak of it as if it's a big deal."
The father and son went out to the balcony together.
As the two appeared, the people gathered in the Garden of Swords let out a cheer so loud it seemed to shake the heavens.
"It reminds me of the old days. The banquet held when you reached 5-star at fifteen."
"Then too, I stood on the balcony with you like this and looked down at the central courtyard, Father."
-How many guests do you think there will be?
-I estimate there will be at least a thousand.
-Yes, I was reported about that much as well. Compared to the last banquet held seven years ago, about two hundred more guests have come. Do you know what that means?
-It means that in the seven years since the last banquet, the power of our family has grown stronger.

-Correct. A banquet with about a thousand people is something that happens often in other families... but the thousand gathered here are each outstanding individuals. There is not a single riffraff or piece of trash among them.
The father and son simultaneously recalled the conversation they had had that day.

"At that time, I told you that if I were to disappear someday, many would turn their backs on Runcandel. But now that you are here, no one would dare to be on bad terms with Runcandel. It is an era you have created."
"It is an era that could not have been achieved without you, Father."
"That's a statement that applies to everyone who fought together. But the protagonist is you. You led the fight to victory."
Jin no longer felt awkward or uncomfortable receiving praise from Chiron.
"What do you want to do when you become the patriarch?"
"I want to live as I please."
"A bold answer, now as it was then. The chief butler will continue to handle the internal affairs anyway, and there will be no need to fight external enemies... It will be a leisurely position."
"What do you want to do from now on, Father?"
Jin asked in a calm voice. Chiron opened his mouth without hesitation.
"I want to be free."
For a long while, the father and son silently looked at the crowd watching them. Time seemed to pass quickly. It was time to begin the succession ceremony.
"Let's go down."
"Yes, Father."

The sound of drums and voices, announcing the start of the event of the century, was echoing. As the guardian knights lined up in perfect order and took their places, the many people simultaneously held their breath.
Chiron and the flag-bearers took their places on the platform first, and Jin stood at the beginning of the path created by the family's knights standing face to face.
The VIP seats on both sides were all filled by Jin's comrades.
The seat of honor was, of course, Gilly's. From the moment Jin had come down, she hadn't been able to hide her reddened eyes.
Jin felt sorry for Gilly. At this very moment, Murakan should have been in the seat next to her.
[The 59th Young Patriarch of Runcandel, Jin Runcandel, come forward.]
It was Lucy.
As a representative of the Runcandel of a thousand years ago, she stood next to Chiron with Leuth, Bale, and her daughter, Haylin. Behind them stood Alpen, Tasha, and Vallas.
The knights all raised their swords in unison and crossed their blades. Jin slowly walked forward between them.
His siblings were waiting at the end of the path. Luna, Luntia, Mary, Yona, Daytona, Haytona. The six flag-bearers, one by one, knelt on one knee to Jin and kissed the back of his hand.
The Runcandel patriarch succession ceremony originally involved many more rituals, but Chiron and Jin had decided to keep it as simple as possible.
The intention was not to bore the people who had been waiting outside for anywhere from a few days to over a month, as a banquet was also scheduled along with the succession ceremony.
Soon, Jin knelt on one knee before Chiron.
"Jin."
"I am listening, Patriarch."

"The position of Patriarch of Runcandel is just a hollow title. What you have accomplished, what battles you have fought, what a great era you have opened... the whole world knows these facts now, even without such a title. Rise."
Jin, getting up and standing face to face with Chiron.

"From today, the sole master of this garden is you, Jin Runcandel. You must have lived feeling indebted to the world, but the world also owes you a great debt. So from now on, live as you please. Do not be bound by the title of patriarch. You have already fulfilled your responsibility to the family and the world."
Fulfilled his responsibility to the family and the world.
Jin didn't actually think so. But hearing those words directly from his father, he felt as if a heavy weight in his chest had been washed away a little.

"It's a bit anticlimactic, but the succession ceremony ends here. As of today, I am no longer the patriarch of Runcandel but a single knight, so I hope everyone will treat me not so formally at the banquet that will continue for the next ten days. The boring time is over, so everyone, please enjoy yourselves. Lastly, I would like to ask for a round of applause for my son who has become the patriarch."
Chiron asking for applause for someone was a very unfamiliar scene. It was even more so for those who knew him.
But to those who had gotten to know him well after the war, it was not such a big deal. He was no longer a father who was just fearsome, difficult, and distant to his children.
Poof, bang, pa-ba-bang!
While the applause continued without end, colorful magic and fireworks dyed the sky in various colors.

"Alright! Then from now on, we will begin the Runcandel banquet, the Single-Log Bridge Party! If there are still grudges you haven't been able to settle even after the world met its end and came back, have a good fight at this banquet and shake it all off!"

[As you all know, at this banquet, you can specially request a duel with all the knights of Runcandel, including the new patriarch, Lord Jin Runcandel, and all the martial artists of the Vamel Alliance. Who will be the lucky protagonist to receive the sword of Patriarch Lord Jin Runcandel, Sword God Lord Chiron Runcandel, Battle God Lord Vahn, White Whale Lord Luna Runcandel, and Demonic Beast King Lord Orgal! Challengers are guaranteed to have no injuries worse than a fracture!]
As Jet and Ozdok raised their voices, tables filled with drinks and meat suddenly appeared from all directions.

At the same time, all the gates in the garden leading to the banquet hall were opened, and the martial artists were rushing in, competing as if in a race. With the thought of, if not today, when will I ever get to cross swords with these legends?
"Actually, this will be an annual sparring event from now on, so it feels like I'm lying as soon as I become the patriarch."
"You will be away from the Garden of Swords for quite a long time after the banquet, won't you? So it's not a lie. No one will be able to request a duel with you at the next banquet."
"That's true, Father. It is a bit embarrassing and apologetic to leave the Garden of Swords for so long as soon as I become the patriarch."
At those words, Chiron grinned.
"This father has spent more time in the Black Sea than in the Garden of Swords. Are you trying to make me feel self-conscious?"
"So this is the taste of the power of a sword family's patriarch..."
The father and son chuckled together and walked towards the banquet hall.
And for ten days.
The main figures of the Demon God War received countless challenges but never once lost, once again imprinting the dignity of Runcandel and the Vamel Alliance on the people.
"...It's already been ten days. I was surprised that there were far more people settling their grudges at the banquet than I thought."

"That's right, Young Master. But it seems there aren't that many people who consider each other mortal enemies anymore. In the future, the banquet will also serve the role of resolving moderate grudges between people."
"Like a cute war, huh? If that reduces the possibility of a real war even a little, it wouldn't be a bad idea to hold banquets more often."
Jin looked at the strawberry pie on the table.

To be precise, it was the remains of a strawberry pie. His comrades and siblings had already devoured it greedily, as if fighting over Gilly's strawberry pie, which they hadn't seen in a long time, leaving only the scent of strawberries and crumbs.
I'm sorry, Gilly.
Jin swallowed those words. Those words would only make Gilly sadder. They would only be words that would bring out the pained face she was trying so hard to hide.
"I'm sorry, Young Master."
But suddenly, it was Gilly who looked at Jin first and lowered her head.
"...Suddenly? What for? First, raise your head. Gilly, you're a person who never needs to apologize to me for anything, no matter what you do in the future."
Gilly buried her face in Jin's shoulder for a long while and swallowed her tears. Jin patted her back, which was shaking as she held back her sobs.
"Young Master..."
"Yeah, Gilly."
"Lord Chiron... left this note for you."
On the note that Gilly took out from her bosom, this sentence was written.
(You've become the patriarch, yet this father has not yet passed Barisada to you.
Come and get it. I'll be waiting in the Black Sea.)
